label: Last-trial outcome at D1; belief-toward-S2 at GO; a1-rare-S2 dip at D2
explanation: Raw reset gate r33 (timing alone R^2 0.60; D1 ~0.63, GO ~0.40, D2 ~0.83). Beyond timing, observed-only terms reach test R^2 0.77 (all ceiling 0.91, all-observed 0.85; the earlier model-policy reference was 0.62 for policy decile alone). D1: set by the previous trial's choice x state x reward: lowest after a1->S2 unrewarded (-0.36), low after a1 S1 u, a1 S2 r, a2 S2 u; highest after a2->S1 rewarded (+0.2), a2 S2 r and a1 S1 r mildly up; two unrewarded trials in a row push it lower still (small gain). GO: higher after a2 trials and lower after a1 trials (a1 S1 r -0.19, a2 S1 u +0.22), plus a graded decrease with the ideal-observer log-odds that S1 is good (belief decile 0 +0.16 vs 9 -0.17); this stands in for the upcoming choice / policy (GO residual +-0.14 by upcoming choice). D2: strong dip when a1 leads to rare S2 (-0.235), up when a2 is chosen (a2->S1 +0.12), with a weak previous-trial carryover. Reward of the current trial (future) explains nothing (0.01). Using only observed quantities loses little: belief_lo replaces the policy term.

issues: Reported score reproduces: the six terms give test R^2 beyond timing 0.771 (total R^2 0.909, timing only 0.602). The D1, GO and D2 previous-trial tables match the profile's residual tables exactly (for example D1 after a1 S2 u -0.359, D1 after a2 S1 r +0.200, GO after a2 S1 u +0.217, D2 after a1 S2R -0.235).

Systematic gap the label misses: at D1 on each window's first trial, prev_action is -1, so every prev-trial table returns 0. The reward input is still observed there and it drives r33 strongly. The worst-fit windows all start with this case, e.g. r0 actual 0.21 vs predicted 0.65, and 0.22 vs 0.62. Adding (phase==D1)*(prev_action==-1)*(2*prev_reward-1) raises test R^2 from 0.767 to 0.806 (about +0.035). This is mostly a windowing artefact, but it is the largest single error class.

The GO belief term is real but small. Dropping it moves test R^2 from 0.771 to 0.740. GO belief alone scores 0.26, against 0.62 for the policy decile. So 'belief_lo replaces the policy term' only holds alongside the GO previous-trial table. On its own, belief recovers well under half of what the policy decile does.
The 'two unrewarded trials in a row push it lower' term is close to negligible: test R^2 0.767 without it vs 0.771 with it.

Belief also matters at D1 and D2 (profile: D1 belief decile 0 +0.10 vs decile 9 -0.08; D2 +0.09 vs -0.12). The label puts belief only at GO. Adding D1 belief, plus belief x previous reward, adds about +0.01.
Remaining errors are modest: GO after a2 S2 u is under-predicted by +0.066, GO after a1 S2 u by +0.039, and D1 after a2 S1 u is over-predicted by -0.05 with the extended terms. None is large.
No future variables are used; the D2 action x state term is observable at D2. The '85% of ceiling' figure (0.77/0.91) is correct; against the 'all observed' ceiling of 0.85 the terms cover about 91%.
